verdict.rationale: Framework route-protection middleware is a fair axis for an authentication platform like Auth0, but the evidence pack never documents a Next.js (or peer) SDK, route-protection middleware, or edge session verification. The nearest items are a generic pointer to quickstart tutorials and a list of AI-agent frameworks for Token Vault. Neither covers protecting routes or verifying sessions at the edge.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect routes with first-party framework SDKs and middleware (Next.js and peers) that verify sessions at the edge
